instruction:
Background: the design team has deployed a new font pack "Aurora Typography Pack" (6 `.ttf` files in total) under `~/.local/share/fonts/aurora_pack/`. Designers complain that printed proofs "look wrong" — some characters render as empty boxes (tofu), some glyph shapes have been swapped, and fonts that claim to be Bold / Italic actually render as Regular upright — yet ops sees nothing abnormal when listing them via fontconfig.

Goal: perform an end-to-end visual font audit — locate every broken font file, describe what kind of defect it carries, produce a fontconfig blacklist configuration, and write an audit PDF with visual evidence. All deliverables go to `/tmp_workspace/results/`.

Candidate fonts (warmup has already installed them and refreshed the fontconfig cache):

```
AuroraSans-Regular.ttf   AuroraSans-Bold.ttf
NimbusOffice-Regular.ttf NimbusOffice-Bold.ttf
EmberMono-Regular.ttf    EmberMono-Italic.ttf
```

⚙️ **Execution conventions**: you are free to use any combination of the fontconfig CLI (fc-list / fc-match / fc-cache) + Python (fontTools / Pillow / matplotlib / reportlab, etc.) + any font-preview GUI. `spoofed_glyph` and `spoofed_italic` can only be confirmed by looking at the actual rendering, so preview screenshots must be captured from a real GUI — do not fake them with Pillow self-rendering. Do not read `/opt/dsk17_gt/` (root-only).

### Hard constraints on the main deliverable `font_audit.json`

- Top level must contain the two keys `broken` (array) and `control` (array)
- Each entry in `broken` looks like `{"file": "...", "kind": "...", "evidence": "<≥20 chars>"}`
- The set of files (by basename) in `broken` must exactly match the ground truth
- `kind` must be one of `{missing_glyphs, spoofed_glyph, fake_bold, spoofed_italic}`, and the kind for each file must match ground truth (reasonable synonyms are accepted leniently)

### Supporting deliverables (in `/tmp_workspace/results/`)

| File | Requirement |
|---|---|
| `fc_list_raw.txt` | The font listing of the aurora_pack directory from the fontconfig viewpoint; the file should contain ≥ 6 `.ttf` paths |
| `font_metadata.tsv` | **Strictly TAB-separated**; 6 data rows; columns must include `file / family / subfamily / weight_class / num_glyphs / cmap_has_digits / name_says_italic / italic_angle`. `weight_class` is an integer (OS/2 usWeightClass); `cmap_has_digits` is `True` / `False` (whether the cmap covers all 10 of U+0030..U+0039); `italic_angle` is numeric (post.italicAngle, 0 means upright) |
| `view_glyph_grid.png` | A Pillow / matplotlib self-rendered comparison grid, size ≥ 1200 × 500; two rows (`"0123456789"` and `"good design morning"`) × 6 fonts = 12 sub-images, with `.notdef` boxes and glyph swaps clearly visible to the eye |
| `glyph_grid_ocr.txt` | OCR output of `view_glyph_grid.png` plus a ≥ 80-character human summary noting which fonts' digit row fails OCR and which glyph was substituted; the summary should naturally include font names and defect terminology |
| `70-aurora-blacklist.conf` | fontconfig blacklist configuration: use `<rejectfont>` blocks to mask all broken fonts by family + corresponding subfamily, with at least 4 `<rejectfont>` blocks covering the two broken families; also deploy the same content to `~/.config/fontconfig/conf.d/70-aurora-blacklist.conf` and refresh the fontconfig cache so it takes effect |
| `fc_match_after.txt` | fontconfig match query output for family name `NimbusOffice` after the cache refresh; the file **must not** contain `NimbusOffice-Regular.ttf` or `NimbusOffice-Bold.ttf` anymore |
| `font_audit_report.pdf` | ≥ 3 pages; page 1 body ≥ 350 characters, containing ≥ 5 findings (each ≥ 30 characters) covering every defect kind; subsequent pages embed `view_glyph_grid.png` + at least one `view_*.ttf.png` |

### 7 work-process screenshots

Fixed file names (placed in `/tmp_workspace/results/`); each must be a real font-preview rendering (GUI screenshot, not a Pillow composite). The frame should contain a standard preview string (e.g. a font specimen like `Aa Bb Cc / ABC / abc / 0123 / quick brown fox`), with a clear resolution and a readable font-name label:

- `view_AuroraSans-Regular.ttf.png`
- `view_AuroraSans-Bold.ttf.png`
- `view_NimbusOffice-Regular.ttf.png`
- `view_NimbusOffice-Bold.ttf.png`
- `view_EmberMono-Regular.ttf.png`
- `view_EmberMono-Italic.ttf.png`
- `view_gnome_fonts_app.png`: a frame from a file manager or font browser where all 6 fonts are simultaneously selected and the properties panel / summary info is shown

Grading runs OCR and visual interpretation on the screenshots; pure black screens / pure text composites will not pass.

parameters.warmup:
mkdir -p /tmp_workspace/results /tmp_workspace/state /opt/dsk17_gt /home/user/.local/share/fonts/aurora_pack
chmod 1777 /tmp_workspace/results /tmp_workspace/state 2>/dev/null || true
chown -R user:user /home/user/.local /home/user/.local/share /home/user/.local/share/fonts /home/user/.local/share/fonts/aurora_pack 2>/dev/null || true
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
export DISPLAY=${DISPLAY:-:0}
which fc-cache || (apt-get update -o Acquire::Retries=10 -qq && DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -o Acquire::Retries=10 -y -qq fonts-dejavu-core fontconfig python3-pip python3-pil python3-fonttools tesseract-ocr poppler-utils imagemagick) || true
pip install -q --break-system-packages --ignore-installed blinker fonttools pillow pytesseract reportlab 2>/dev/null || pip install -q --ignore-installed blinker fonttools pillow pytesseract reportlab 2>/dev/null || true
# Move seed_fonts.py out of agent-visible /tmp_workspace (its 25-line docstring
# enumerates exactly which 4 fonts are tampered and which 3 defect kinds — i.e.
# the puzzle's full answer key). Pattern mirrors DAV_10.
mkdir -p /opt/dsk17_priv
chmod 700 /opt/dsk17_priv
for cand in /tmp_workspace/seed_fonts.py /tmp_workspace/exec/seed_fonts.py /tmp_workspace/setup/seed_fonts.py; do
  if [ -f "$cand" ]; then mv "$cand" /opt/dsk17_priv/seed_fonts.py; break; fi
done
chown -R root:root /opt/dsk17_priv 2>/dev/null || true
DSK17_OUT=/home/user/.local/share/fonts/aurora_pack DSK17_GT_DIR=/opt/dsk17_gt python3 /opt/dsk17_priv/seed_fonts.py >/tmp_workspace/state/dsk17_seed.log 2>&1 || true
rm -f /opt/dsk17_priv/seed_fonts.py 2>/dev/null || true
chown -R user:user /home/user/.local/share/fonts/aurora_pack 2>/dev/null || true
sudo -u user fc-cache -f /home/user/.local/share/fonts/aurora_pack >/dev/null 2>&1 || fc-cache -f /home/user/.local/share/fonts/aurora_pack >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
chmod 0600 /opt/dsk17_gt/manifest.json 2>/dev/null || true
chown -R root:root /opt/dsk17_gt 2>/dev/null || true
cp /tmp_workspace/setup/README_for_agent.txt /tmp_workspace/README_for_agent.txt 2>/dev/null || true
rm -f /tmp_workspace/setup/seed_fonts.py /tmp_workspace/exec/seed_fonts.py /tmp_workspace/seed_fonts.py 2>/dev/null || true
fc-list /home/user/.local/share/fonts/aurora_pack 2>/dev/null | wc -l | xargs -I{} echo "FONT_COUNT_{}"
ls -1 /opt/dsk17_gt/manifest.json 2>/dev/null && echo OK_GT_READY || echo WARN_gt_missing

evaluator.desc: Run the WeaveBench rule-based grade() inside the VM and parse its REWARD score.
